title: Decay and preconditioning do not commute
promptMarkdown: Let w=(2,2), g=(1,1), P=diag(1,10), η=.1 andλ=.2. Compare the coupled L2 update w−ηP(g+λw) with independent decay(1−ηλ) w−ηPg. Calculate both. Derive a condition for equality for an arbitrary w with this fixedP. Explain why the distinction can persist in an adaptive optimiser even beyond this single update.
hintLadder: Distribute P through the penalty term.
Subtract the two symbolic updates before inserting numbers.
Ask whether the gradient accumulator sees the penalty.
